name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: patient_has_suspicion_of_acute_appendicitis_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently suspected to have acute appendicitis.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently suspected to have acute appendicitis.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not suspected to have acute appendicitis.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently suspected to have acute appendicitis.

name: patient_can_undergo_laparoscopy_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently suitable for and able to undergo laparoscopy.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently suitable for and able to undergo laparoscopy.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not suitable for or cannot undergo laparoscopy.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is suitable for laparoscopy at this time.

name: patient_has_access_to_laparoscopic_surgeon_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether there is currently a laparoscopic surgeon available for the patient.
when_true: Set to true if there is currently a laparoscopic surgeon available for the patient.
when_false: Set to false if there is currently no laparoscopic surgeon available for the patient.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether there is currently a laparoscopic surgeon available for the patient.
